notes: `image` is a normalized (u, v) coordinate read off the estate master, origin top-left.
`world` is the matching point in game space (metres, Y-up, -Z away from the camera).
Anchors are deliberately limited to large unambiguous structure. Paint, players, palm
fronds, shadows and small props are excluded — they are too variable to fit a camera to.
`kind` separates the structural anchors that the camera acceptance gate is scored on
from context anchors that are reported but not scored.

The two near perimeter corners are outside the reference frame: the estate is cropped at the bottom. They are kept as context anchors so the omission is explicit, but the camera is never scored on them.

The camera is fitted only to anchors whose world position is structurally certain (arena footprint corners, fountain centre, horizon). Villa, bridge and orb anchors are proxy geometry the reference disagrees with, so their residuals are read as a correction list for Phase A rather than fed back into the camera.

The far perimeter corners are hidden behind the villas in the reference; what is visible at the frame edges is side fence at unknown depth. They are annotated as best-effort and must not be treated as certain constraints — fitting a camera to them alone produced a self-consistent but wrong result.
